DOB: 09/18/1947
MRN: MRN-41509

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Mark Harris, Maple Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of persistent fatigue in the setting of a strong family history of premature heart disease.

Edwin Avery is a 79-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. He reports persistent fatigue that has gradually worsened over several months.

I am requesting cardiology evaluation of his persistent fatigue given his strong family history of premature heart disease. His father had a heart attack in his early 50s, and his brother developed heart disease before age 55.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Mark Harris
Maple Family Practice
